mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust residential construction activity, which signals strengthening consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above its 3-month moving average fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (positive returns <40% of periods).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL inflation above 2.0% and stable FEDFUNDS (≤0.5%) indicates insufficient monetary policy response to inflation, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The CPIAUCSL>2.0 and FEDFUNDS<=0.5 interaction signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 30% of cases over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) reflects tight labor markets that boost corporate profit margins through wage growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) during UNRATE<4.5% regimes over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 102.0) indicates robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 102.0 fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining retail sales (RSAFS < 440,000 million dollars) signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 440,000 fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth (PAYEMS > 150,000 thousand) and housing starts expansion (HOUST > 1,200 thousand) indicate a synchronized labor and housing market boom, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The PAYEMS>150,000 and HOUST>1,200 joint signal fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) triggers Federal Reserve monetary tightening expectations, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) during CPIAUCSL>2.5% regimes over any 2-year rolling window.
